title: A Text-to-SQL Benchmark for Official Statistics
abstract: arXiv:2611.32646v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Official statistics are critical datasets for a wide variety of actors, including policymakers and businesses. For providers of official statistics, improving accessibility, governance, and disclosure of their data is of key importance. This can be improved by providing question-answering systems based on text-to-SQL approaches. However, existing text-to-SQL benchmarks do not resemble this setting. Official statistics are published as open-domain catalogs of thousands of wide tables whose columns and values are codes, and whose meaning is recorded in separate metadata rather than in a relational schema. To address this gap, we introduce LOCuST, a text-to-SQL benchmark that pairs over two thousand English and Dutch tables from Statistics Netherlands with a semantic knowledge graph. The graph describes the tables, measures, and dimension codes through labels, definitions, hierarchies, and units, and is the external knowledge a system needs

translated_title: 面向官方统计数据的Text-to-SQL基准测试
translated_abstract: 官方统计是包括政策制定者和企业在内的各类主体的重要数据集。对于官方统计的提供者而言，提升其数据的可访问性、治理和披露水平至关重要，而基于text-to-SQL方法构建的问答系统可以改善这一点。然而，现有的text-to-SQL基准测试并不符合这一应用场景。官方统计以开放域目录的形式发布，包含数千个宽表，其列名和取值均为编码，其含义记录在独立的元数据中，而非关系模式内。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了LOCuST，这是一个text-to-SQL基准，它将来自荷兰统计局的超过两千个英语和荷兰语表格与语义知识图谱相配对。该知识图谱通过标签、定义、层级结构和计量单位来描述表格、度量指标和维度编码，是系统完成该任务所需的外部知识。
tldr: 本文提出了LOCuST——首个面向官方统计场景的text-to-SQL基准，将荷兰统计局两千余个多语言宽表与语义知识图谱相结合，以应对现有基准无法模拟编码式列名和外部元数据等官方统计特点的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces LOCuST, a text-to-SQL benchmark for official statistics that pairs over two thousand English and Dutch wide tables from Statistics Netherlands with a semantic knowledge graph, addressing the gap where existing benchmarks fail to reflect the coded columns and external metadata characteristic of official statistics.
